definitions.explanation: Sugar pressed into small cube shapes for convenient use in drinks like coffee and tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{角砂糖|かくざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put a sugar cube in my coffee.

examples.japanese: {角砂糖|かくざとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何個|なんこ}→何個：26687_nanko⟧⟦{入|い}れます→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many sugar cubes would you like?

examples.japanese: ⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{角砂糖|かくざとう}{十個分|じゅっこぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised to hear that one bottle of juice contains the equivalent of ten sugar cubes of sugar.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {角|かく} (square, cube) + ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ (sugar). Sugar cubes are often used as a unit of measurement to illustrate how much sugar is in food and drinks. Counted with ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {角砂糖|かくざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to add a sugar cube)
- {角砂糖|かくざとう}～{個分|こぶん} (equivalent to ~ sugar cubes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黒砂糖|くろざとう}→黒砂糖：18292_kurozatou⟧: brown sugar — unrefined sugar with a dark color
- ⟦{白砂糖|しろざとう}→白砂糖：26404_shirozatou⟧: white sugar — standard refined granulated sugar
- ⟦グラニュー{糖|とう}→グラニュー糖：23996_guranyuutou⟧: granulated sugar — fine white sugar for baking
